We need to get list of all airports. Then get flight cost from first to last airport on 2024-10-31 business class. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight quickly. We might need to book flight. But they didn't specify card. We can just compute cost. But they want estimated total payable amount. That likely includes flight cost plus maybe insurance? Not specified. So just flight cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to. We need to get list of airports. So call list_all_airports. Then pick first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide cost. Also maybe we need to compute exchange rate? They want USD. So no conversion needed.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
